statement: Not one folio in the Crusades corpus has been transcribed. Every locator in source-audit.csv, itinerary-stages.csv and fourth-crusade-states.csv reads pending, which is why all twenty-two data rows sit at raw.
resolution_path: Read the folios the prototypes use and record the locator on each row. The stage validator refuses a stage above raw without one, so this single act moves both proofs' data gates.

statement: No manuscript witness is cleared for publication. Six of the nine audited sources need a rights review and the digitised-image terms for the three Matthew Paris manuscripts have not been read, so the Road proof cannot show the manuscript it argues about.
resolution_path: Read the British Library and Parker Library terms and clear at least one itinerary witness, or record the decision to argue from Luard's edition and a redrawing instead.

statement: Matthew Paris left more than one itinerary copy and this project has not chosen which witness it stands on. Royal 14 C VII, CCCC 26 and CCCC 16 are all registered and they differ.
resolution_path: Collate the three witnesses and record the choice with its reason, so the folio transcription that follows is done once against the right manuscript.

statement: The twenty core places are compiled and normalized, which is as far as machine-assisted work may take them. None has been reviewed against a source by a named researcher.
resolution_path: A named researcher checks each place against its cited source and records the review, following the same promotion rules as the Dacia corpus.

statement: Choniates is recorded as in copyright. The Fourth Crusade's second assault and the durable-control reconstruction both cite it, so two of the eight state records rest on a source that cannot be quoted at length.
resolution_path: Identify a public-domain edition or translation for the passages actually cited, or confine the citation to locator-level reference without quotation.

statement: No prose in the prototype has been read against its evidence by a named editor, and it may not be, because the evidence it would be read against is not yet reviewed.
resolution_path: Close the research and data gates first. Editorial review of claims resting on unreviewed rows would certify the prose against material that is itself uncertified.

statement: The Fourth Crusade Atlas layers render through the generic feature panel, which shows a feature's fields but not the distinction the proof is built on. A partition claim and a travelled route are presented alike on the map even though the essay island keeps them apart.
resolution_path: Give the Atlas feature panel the claimed-versus-held distinction the dataset already carries, so a reader who arrives from the Atlas rather than the essay sees the same separation.
